consumer.rule: ceil(headroom * maintained p95 physical value / quantum) * quantum then clamp; requests=limits; classes diagnostic only
consumer.signal_inputs: CPU/memory maintained p95 only; no SLO feedback, prediction, adaptive detector, smoothing or tuned hysteresis

endpoints.actuation_latency: patch submission through status.resources AND cgroup enforcement; record rejected/deferred/timeouts/restarts
endpoints.latency_p50_p95_p99: successful arrival-to-completion latency including generator lag; failure/timeout denominator reported separately
endpoints.maintenance_overhead: separate profile service process CPU/RSS, per-step wall/CPU duration, state bytes and refresh/write/change counts
endpoints.over_provisioning: integral max(request-used,0), resource-time units; not money
endpoints.recommendation_latency: snapshot read through recommendation computation, wall and process CPU timers
endpoints.requested_cpu_memory: desired Pod spec and observed status; Guaranteed requests=limits; cgroup confirmation
endpoints.resource_changes: actual changed CPU/memory allocations, distinct from profile refreshes; churn=sum absolute per-resource changes
endpoints.slo_violation_rate: all offered requests, failures included; run-level endpoint
endpoints.throughput: successful completions within fixed window / window seconds
endpoints.under_provisioning: observed deficit lower bounds plus CPU throttled-period fraction, memory OOM and SLO; enforced limits censor latent demand
endpoints.used_cpu_memory: actual CPU-counter rates and cgroup memory working set
endpoints.utilization_efficiency: resource-time used / resource-time requested, separately CPU and memory

future_trials.bootstrap_source: actual completed telemetry only; no fixture or time compression
future_trials.primary_unit: independent run/scenario replicate, never requests or telemetry points

kubernetes.actuation: pods/resize strategic merge; NotRequired restart policy; no rollout fallback
kubernetes.note: pinned stable in-place resize environment; 1.33 rejected no-restart memory decrease; no controller parameter changes
kubernetes.resource_qos: Guaranteed: requests equal limits before/after resize

question: How do the five maintained observation-profile contracts affect the same resource recommender, enforced Kubernetes allocations, application SLO and resource use?

references.rule: fixed bootstrap reference, never current changing requests

slo.violation: failed/timed-out/dropped OR arrival-to-completion > target, divided by offered requests

telemetry.cpu: counter difference over source monotonic span for host-receipt-selected samples; no extrapolation
telemetry.fence: host receipt inside (bucket_start,bucket_end]; host admission before algorithm use; source causality checked only against cluster receipt; incomplete buckets absent
telemetry.late_read: record wall receive/commit/read times separately from nominal policy slot; never consume incomplete source
telemetry.memory: mean of actual cgroup working-set bytes in bucket

workload.arrival: deterministic open loop; overload drops recorded as failures
workload.generator_location: host through fixed localhost kubectl port-forward; transport part of measured system, not production ingress
